extracted.intended_audience: Ohio businesses, regulated stakeholders, and state agency rulewriters
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance describing the Ohio Common Sense Initiative's functions for reviewing business-impacting state agency rules, identifying regulatory obstacles to businesses, and resources for complying with or tracking rule changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review business-impacting rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI reviews state agency rules that have an impact on businesses; this is a core function of the program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Help businesses navigate regulatory obstacles
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI provides assistance to businesses encountering regulatory barriers; wording implies an expectation of outreach and support to affected businesses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lead initiatives to improve Ohio’s regulatory climate
rubrics_metrics.description: leads initiatives to improve Ohio’s regulatory climate
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI undertakes broader projects and initiatives aimed at improving the overall regulatory environment in the state.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify potential obstacles to Ohio businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: identified over 55 percent of those regulations as potential obstacles to Ohio businesses
rubrics_metrics.guidance: During the DeWine Administration CSI reviewed more than 17,000 state agency rules and determined that over 55% were potential obstacles to businesses — indicating the program evaluates rules for being 'potential obstacles to businesses.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Amend or rescind regulations judged to be obstacles
rubrics_metrics.description: All of those identified regulations were either amended or rescinded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI's process results in regulatory change: regulations identified as obstacles have been amended or rescinded; this describes the expected remedial actions when obstacles are found.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide and use Business Impact Analysis (BIA) templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Business Impact Analysis Template; Business Impact Analysis Template for Rescinded Rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI links to BIA templates (including a template for rescinded rules) under Related Laws & Forms, indicating a required or recommended format for documenting business impacts of rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subscribe to eNotifications for agency rule review updates
rubrics_metrics.description: To receive agency rule review eNotifications, please visit the eNotifications page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI encourages stakeholders to sign up for eNotifications to stay informed about rule reviews and news impacting business.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult Register of Ohio and related laws & forms as resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Register of Ohio; Related Laws & Forms; View Other Laws & Forms
rubrics_metrics.guidance: CSI points stakeholders to the Register of Ohio and related laws/forms as primary resources for rule and statutory information.
